notes: Winged creature (cindermoth). Winged-v1 rig template with hover gait, ember body, plum and linen wings, sand belly, glowing gold antennae. creature.small canvas (40x44, anchor 20,34).

fields.description: a fluttering spark of warmth that pollinates hardy mountain wildflowers
fields.anatomy: fuzzy moth body with curved feathery antennae, twin pairs of patterned moth wings held spread wide, tiny tucked legs beneath fuzzy thorax, gentle glowing embers along wing margins
fields.colours: warm ember orange fuzzy body, dusty plum-purple and rose wings with amber borders, warm sand underbelly, glowing gold feathery antennae
